# Teaching That Makes Sense

> > Teaching That Makes Sense provides comprehensive K-12 educational products, professional development, and evidence-based instructional strategies for reading and writing.

TTMS offers a suite of resources including the Writing Teacher's Strategy Guide, assessment tools, and curriculum materials designed to improve literacy instruction across elementary and secondary schools. The organization combines professional development consulting with practical classroom resources and teacher training programs.

## Key Topics

- Writing Teacher's Strategy Guide
- Six Traits Assessment
- Reading Comprehension Strategies
- Writing Process Instruction
- Professional Development
- Curriculum Resources
- K-12 Education
- Writing Assessment
- Teacher Training
- Literacy Instruction
- Educational Consulting
- Grading Systems
- Student Writing Samples
- Writer's Workshop

## Core Products & Services

- [Teaching That Makes Sense](https://ttms.org): Homepage for Teaching That Makes Sense with core K-12 educational products for reading, writing, and grading systems
- [Products](https://www.ttms.org/products/products.htm): Products catalog featuring Writing Teacher's Strategy Guide and assessment tools for educators
- [Services](https://www.ttms.org/services/services.htm): Services overview including writing instruction, professional development workshops, and curriculum resources

## Writing Instruction & Assessment

- [Writing: Communicative Conventions](https://www.ttms.org/writing_quality/conventions.htm): Writing conventions guide using Six Traits Assessment for teaching grammar, mechanics, punctuation, and spelling

## Reading Strategies & Comprehension

- [Reading: Comprehending Comprehension](https://www.ttms.org/say_about_a_book/comprehending_comprehension.htm): Guide on reading comprehension strategies and evidence-based literacy instruction techniques for K-12

## Support & Contact

- [Contact](https://www.ttms.org/contact/contact.htm): Contact page for Teaching That Makes Sense professional development services and consulting inquiries
